t: The Command Line is the Contract: Forging a Future-Proof AI Framework
s: This article advocates for a future-proof AI framework by adopting the Command Line Interface (CLI) as a universal API, emphasizing stability and enduring technologies like Unix and Nix Flakes over constantly changing high-level abstractions.
sub: Pipulate framework development and the challenge of future-proofing
The Command-Line Interface (CLI) as a universal API for AI tools
Historical evolution of computing infrastructure from vacuum tubes to Unix/Nix
Philosophy of 'standing on the shoulders of giants' with stable technologies
Leveraging Nix Flakes for Infrastructure-as-Code and cross-platform stability
